??? quote "Dialogue"

    - Look at her. The old rim, with Ferro's band round it, and a name inside where nobody looks. I will not tell you the name. I cried when I read it.
    - New spokes, from your wood. Do not look at the rim. Look at the spokes. Lovely spokes.
    - Did you hear Drum last night? That deep boom under everything? That is my old theatre washtub. Best sound it ever made, and it washed a lot of costumes.
    - Juna's play has gone round the square on a cart every Walkout Day for a hundred years, *Player*, and for forty of them it has been my cart to keep. What can I tell you?
        - *Choice:* Tell me about the cart.
        - *Choice:* Why are you called Hambone?
        - *Choice:* Is something wrong with that wheel?
        - *Choice:* Nothing, thanks.
    - Fenwick Corliss kept it before me, a wheelwright, and he had it from the keepers before him. Those three dark, worn planks in the middle of the stage, those are from Juna's own cart. Fenwick told me so.
    - Ozzie has never found a letter to say so, nor one to say not. So I choose to believe it. Every Walkout Day, Juna's planks go round the square again.
    - My second season, under Bellamy Stroud. I played the back half of a prize pig in one of his farces, and the crowd threw sausages. The name stuck. My real one did not. I barely remember it myself.
    - Wrong? With the wheel? Which wheel? No. Nothing. It squeaks. Wheels squeak. Why would you ask about the left rear one in particular? I never said left rear.
    - Not any more. Spokes from the Bristlewood, a band from Ferro's forge, and the old wood where it always was. She will roll another hundred years. Well. Another fifty. I will settle for fifty.
    - Off you go. Hm hm hmm...
